newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Quake hits Azerbaijan, no casualties - Interfax.
newsitem.headline: Quake hits Azerbaijan, no casualties - Interfax.

text.p: An earthquake measuring four points on the Richter scale hit the Azeri capital Baku late on Wednesday but there were no reports of casualties or damage to property, Russia's Interfax news agency said.
Interfax quoted the national seismological service as saying that at the epicentre of the quake, some 120 km (80 miles) off Baku in the Caspian Sea, its force reached up to six points.
Officials in Baku could not be reached for comment.
Nearly 1,000 people were killed, 2,600 injured and 36,000 made homeless when a 5.5-point quake hit Azerbaijan's southern neighbour Iran on Friday.
